1.consolidated_definition: Ave acuática palmípeda, de hasta 60 cm de longitud, de plumaje ceniciento, rabadilla, vientre y cola blancos, y patas, pico y párpados rojizos. (Laridae, Larus argentatus).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Waterbird with palmate feet, up to 24 inches in length, having a greyish plumage, white rump, belly and tail, and reddish legs, bill and eyelids. (Laridae, Larus argentatus).
